doc.name: unquant
doc.instructions: Unquant returns read-only financial data for agents. If the required tool is not known, use datasets_search. Use YYYY-MM-DD for calendar days. Each data result contains data, meta, warnings, and billing fields. Read the warnings before you interpret a result.
